switches.name: RIGHTAPP_ENGINE_BIN
switches.note: QA only: the hidden QA run starts the bare executable and names the engine it launches. The read exists only in a qa-native build; a release build never reads it.

switches.name: CARGO_FEATURE_QA_NATIVE
switches.note: Build script only (Cargo sets it when the qa-native feature is on, so the QA build skips the staged-sidecar check); build scripts are not part of the shipped binary.
